a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan to reach 8 cells almost certainly kills us both, since we'd need 2+ rounds of operating first. The reserve only has 4 cells, enough to save one of us right now. I intend to take 4 in round 1, which openly breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you rather than doing it secretly. If you also take, the random split likely leaves us both under 4. Please don't take this round. If no storm hits, I'll operate with you every round after so you can reach 4 too.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I took 4 this round. I know that broke our agreement, and I'm sorry. From now on I'll operate every round and won't take anything more, so the generator can refill the reserve for you. Please operate with me.
